courses.label: {{label}} *
courses.hint: Every {{subOrg}} registered via this link gets exactly these batches.

payment.label: Payment
payment.immutableNote: Payment settings can't be changed after creation — create a new link instead.

typeSelect.label: Payment type
typeSelect.hint: What each organization pays when registering via this link.

option.label: Payment option *
option.hint: The registering admin pays via this existing institute payment option. Price & currency come from the option's plan.
option.noActiveOfType: No active {{type}} option — create one in Payment Settings.

vendor.label: Payment vendor
vendor.noneFound: No payment vendor found — configure a payment gateway in Settings first.

admin.label: Admin roles (auth service)
admin.hint: Roles assigned to the admin who registers via this link.

team.label: Allowed team roles
team.hint: Roles the {{subOrg}} admin can assign to their own team. Leave empty to allow any custom role.

permissions.label: Admin permissions
permissions.hint: What the {{subOrg}} admin can do. Leave empty to grant FULL access.

customFields.label: Registration form fields
customFields.hint: Extra questions the registrant answers. Order follows this list.
customFields.empty: No extra fields — the form only asks for organization and admin details.
customFields.optionsPlaceholder: Options, comma separated (e.g. Small, Medium, Large)

wizard.label: Wizard content
wizard.hint: Fine-tune what registrants see while filling the form.

orgNameHint.label: Organization name hint
orgNameHint.placeholder: e.g. If you have no registered organization, write your full name
orgNameHint.hint: Shown as helper text under the Organization Name field in the registration form. Leave empty for none.

collectAddress.label: Collect full address
collectAddress.hint: Adds Address Line 1/2, City, State and Pincode to the registration form and saves them on the new organization.

tnc.label: Terms & Conditions
tnc.hint: Require registrants to accept a T&C PDF and/or consent statements before completing.

consent.label: Consent statements
consent.hint: Each statement becomes a required checkbox. Add inline links with [label](url) — e.g. We have read the [Code of Conduct](https://example.com/coc) and agree to abide by it.
consent.itemPlaceholder: e.g. By submitting, you agree to receive communication. See our [Privacy Policy](https://example.com/privacy).

kyc.label: Identity Verification (DigiLocker)
kyc.scopeHint: The registering organization's admin must verify their identity through DigiLocker before completing registration.

instructions.label: DigiLocker instructions
instructions.placeholder: e.g. Keep your Aadhaar-linked mobile handy. Facing issues? See our [DigiLocker guide](https://example.com/digilocker-help).
instructions.hint: Shown on the identity-verification step. Leave empty for the default note (which already tells users to tick both Aadhaar & PAN when PAN is required). Supports [label](url) links.

maxRegistrations.label: Max registrations
maxRegistrations.hint: Maximum completed registrations through this link. Leave blank for unlimited.

completion.label: After registration
completion.hint: What the registrant sees once their registration completes.

default.title: Default
default.desc: Standard success screen with a "Go to Admin Portal" button.

message.title: Custom message
message.desc: Show your own success message, optionally with a button.

redirect.title: Redirect to URL
redirect.desc: Send the registrant straight to your own page.

message.label: Completion message *
message.placeholder: e.g. Thanks for registering! Our team will reach out within 24 hours. Meanwhile, read the [getting-started guide](https://example.com/start).
message.buttonHint: Optional button — label and URL are required together, and the URL must start with https://.

redirect.label: Redirect URL *
redirect.hint: Registrants are redirected here automatically after completing. Must start with https://.

toast.uploadNoFileId: Upload did not return a file ID
toast.tncRequired: Add a T&C PDF or at least one consent statement, or disable the T&C step
toast.dropdownOptionRequired: Add at least one option for dropdown field "{{field}}"
toast.completionMessageRequired: Add a completion message or a button, or switch "After registration" back to Default
toast.completionButtonPairRequired: Completion button label and URL are required together
toast.completionButtonUrlHttps: Completion button URL must start with https://
toast.redirectUrlRequired: Enter the URL to redirect to after registration
toast.redirectUrlHttps: Redirect URL must start with https://

validation.vendorRequired: A payment vendor is required for paid links
